children.nl_statement: Subtracting the Gaussian first-chaos projection of a bounded smooth centered symmetric matrix field preserves H1 regularity, removes constants and coordinates, and cancels the first-chaos contributions to the value-minus-gradient energy.
children.role_in_glue: Supplies all hypotheses for the scalar children on each entry of Y and the exact original-to-Y energy cancellation.

children.nl_statement: A smooth Gaussian H1 scalar function orthogonal to constants and coordinates satisfies the sharp improved Poincare inequality with spectral gap two.
children.role_in_glue: Bounds twice the Y energy by its derivative energy, entrywise; also supplies coercivity for the inverse construction.

children.nl_statement: For a smooth scalar Gaussian H1 function with vanishing constant and linear coefficients, construct an L2 weak divergence inverse v whose squared norm is at most half the function energy and whose pairing with its gradient equals the function energy.
children.role_in_glue: Provides the scalar v fields, their exact compact-test divergence, the mixed energy identity, and the half-energy estimate; the glue chooses symmetric matrix representatives and sums.

notes: Three analytic interfaces; the matrix lifting and rational Q estimate are proved glue. Existing x0047 Hermite basis work and shared Gaussian IBP/first-chaos helpers are identified in PROOF.md for the child provers. No new child duplicates the accepted scalar polynomial estimate.
